  - `O3` — unfolding of the goal's two sides via `CONG`/`SYM` (2)
  - `O4` — assembly, two `GEN` steps with their no-open-hypotheses side condition, and final match (3)
- **Tier B (meta-level, 3 obligations)**: soundness review of the six kernel rules, kernel implementation review with negative tests, and a model spot-check on ℤ to upgrade `T ⊢ φ` to "true of the integers".

Each obligation has a precise acceptance criterion and a checkbox; a dependency graph and status table are included. All are marked pending until the kernel run discharges them — the natural next step is implementing `kernel.py` and clearing O0–O4.
